title: Will GTA 6 come out on November 19, 2026?
description:
Why would I bid?
Recently there has been a lot of "leaks" from popular leaker "CYBERLEEK", this has caused the GTA and gaming community to wonder whether or not GTA 6 will be delayed or released early in compensation to these leaks.

Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to YES if Grand Theft Auto VI (GTA 6) is officially released to the general public on November 19, 2026, in any major global market. If the game's release is delayed to a later date, or if it is launched early on any other date, this market will resolve to NO.

title: Will NASA livestream of the August 12, 2026 total solar eclipse exceed 2 million concurrent viewers?
description:
Resolution criteria

This market will resolve to YES if the peak concurrent (simultaneous) viewership of NASA's live broadcast of the August 12, 2026 total solar eclipse exceeds 2,000,000. Otherwise, this market will resolve to NO.

The outcome will be verified using the following priority of sources:

Primary Source: Official post-event articles, metrics summaries, or press releases published by NASA on nasa.gov detailing the official aggregate peak concurrent viewership across its streaming platforms (NASA+, NASA App, NASA.gov, and social media channels).

Secondary Source: If NASA does not publish an official aggregate peak concurrent viewership figure by November 12, 2026, the market will resolve based on the peak concurrent viewer count on NASA's primary official YouTube channel (@NASA) livestream of the eclipse. This peak will be verified using reputable third-party livestream database trackers (e.g., Streams Charts, Playboard) or archived screenshots/records of the live stream's peak viewer count.

Note: If NASA does not host a live broadcast of the August 12, 2026 eclipse, this market will resolve to NO.

Background

On Wednesday, August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will sweep across Greenland, Iceland, northern Russia, the Atlantic Ocean, Spain, and Portugal. NASA has announced that it will host a live broadcast of the event starting at 1:15 p.m. EDT on August 12, featuring views from Iceland and Spain.

Viewership benchmarks for prior eclipses:

2024 Total Solar Eclipse (North America): NASA reported that at its peak, 1,458,212 people watched the eclipse broadcast live across its digital platforms (NASA+, the NASA App, NASA.gov, and NASA social media channels).

2017 Total Solar Eclipse (North America): NASA reported a peak of between 2 million and 3 million simultaneous views on its Eclipse Live page.

Because the 2026 path of totality lies largely outside of the continental United States, interest and viewership patterns may differ from the 2017 and 2024 events.

title: Will the U.S. use a nuclear weapon against Iran’s Pickaxe Mountain between November 4 and November 10, 2026?
description:
Resolution criteria

This market resolves to YES if the United States military uses (detonates) one or more nuclear weapons targeting Iran's Pickaxe Mountain (Kūh-e Kolang Gaz Lā) facility at any point between 12:00 AM UTC on November 4, 2026, and 11:59 PM UTC on November 10, 2026, inclusive.

Otherwise, this market resolves to NO.

Resolution will be determined by credible public reporting or official announcements from the following sources:

U.S. Department of Defense

Reuters

Associated Press

If there is no verified report of a nuclear strike against this location within the specified timeframe, the market will resolve to NO. Conventional strikes or strikes using non-nuclear munitions will not qualify for a YES resolution.

Background

Pickaxe Mountain (Kūh-e Kolang Gaz Lā) is located in Iran's Zagros range, roughly 2 kilometers south of the Natanz nuclear enrichment facility. The site houses a heavily fortified, deep underground tunnel complex widely believed to support Iran's nuclear program. Analysts estimate that parts of the complex are buried 80 to 100 meters beneath solid granite, placing them potentially out of reach for conventional earth-penetrating bunker-buster bombs and fueling debate over whether the U.S. would employ tactical nuclear options in a hypothetical strike.

title: Will Gemini Carbon be released between November 9 and November 15, 2026?
description:
On October 9, 2026, Business Insider reported that Google employees were internally testing a Gemini 4 model codenamed "Carbon," separate from the checkpoint later released as Gemini 4 Argon (https://www.businessinsider.com/google-employees-test-new-gemini-4-model-argon-barium-carbon-2026-10).

This market will resolve according to the calendar date (ET) on which "Carbon", or a model confirmed to be the same model referenced in the report described above, is made available to the general public by Google.

A qualifying model must be a Google AI model named "Carbon" (including variants or successor branding such as Gemini Carbon, Gemini 4 Carbon, or similar naming) or be confirmed to be the same model referenced in the report by Google or by a consensus of credible reporting. A model released under any other name, including a new Gemini model (e.g., Gemini 4.1) or an update to Gemini 4 Argon (including an update released under Argon's existing name or model identifier), will qualify only if it is confirmed by January 3, 2027, 11:59 PM ET to be the same model previously codenamed "Carbon", in which case the date on which it was made available to the general public will be used. Models merely derived from, distilled from, or incorporating improvements from Carbon will not qualify unless confirmed to be the same model.

A qualifying model must be launched and publicly accessible, including via open beta or open rolling waitlist signups. A closed beta or any form of private access will not suffice. The release must either be clearly defined and publicly announced by Google as accessible to the general public, or otherwise be made publicly accessible and explicitly labeled on the company's official website. Labeling errors, placeholder text, or version names displayed on the website that do not correspond to a model that is actually accessible to the general public will not qualify.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from Google; however, a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

title: US announces end of Iranian blockade by November 15, 2026?
description:
On July 13, 2026, Trump announced the United States would reinstate its naval blockade of Iran, targeting Iranian ships and customers.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the United States government, or an authorized representative of the United States government, publicly and officially announces the end, termination, lifting, or suspension of the United States’ naval blockade on Iranian ships and ships of Iranian customers, between market creation and the specified date, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

An announcement qualifies if it communicates that the United States will generally cease blocking vessel traffic for Iranian ships and customers, including an announcement that the blockade will not take effect at all, even if some restrictions remain (for example, an imposition of fees). An announcement does not qualify if it reflects only a limited or partial change that stops short of a general end or suspension of the blockade, for example, an exemption for a specific vessel, cargo, or port.

A qualifying announcement must be a declarative statement of the United States government’s present termination or suspension of the blockade, previously-unannounced prior termination or suspension of the blockade, or definitive decision to terminate or suspend the blockade.

A qualifying announcement must clearly and unambiguously identify the end or suspension of the blockade. Statements that merely allude to, reference, or describe an end to the blockade, without clearly communicating it, do not qualify. The announcement need not use specific terminology or reference the end of a blockade by name; an announcement of a resumption of prior obligations, the maintenance of a status quo, or a return to a previously agreed baseline qualifies, provided the substantive policy of ending or suspending the blockade is clearly and unambiguously communicated.

A qualifying announcement must be made through official channels, by an individual acting in an official capacity. Statements made incidentally or informally in a context not intended for official communication do not qualify.

The following do not qualify:

Anonymous, unattributed, or leaked statements not confirmed as official;
Statements by persons not authorized to speak for the United States government;
Third-party speculation, analysis, or predictions that the United States government will announce or implement an end to the blockade;
Satirical, fabricated, hacked, or impersonated communications; and
Statements that describe a prospective, contingent, probable, or conditional end to the blockade rather than announcing a present and decided position.

Once a qualifying announcement is made, this market will resolve to “Yes” regardless of whether it is later reversed, or whether the blockade actually ends in practice.

Resolution will be based on official information from the United States government, including the President, the Department of Defense, the Department of State, and United States Central Command (CENTCOM), or the official representatives of the United States government.

title: T Coronae Borealis reaches magnitude 5.0 before November 11th, 2026?
description:
Coronae Borealis (T CrB), also known as the 'Blaze Star,' is a recurrent nova expected to undergo an outburst "soon". Historically, it has brightened to magnitude 2.0 or 3.0 during such events in 1866 and 1946 respectively.

This market resolves to 'Yes' if T CrB reaches magnitude 5.0 or brighter before November 11th, 2026 (12:00:00 am ET), as reported by reputable astronomical sources such as the American Association of Variable Star Observers (AAVSO).
